preferences: The human-facing Supervisor autonomously selects planning or planning_claude for each new bounded objective. Honor an explicit Human provider choice; otherwise use planning when neither route has a clear task advantage. Never create that Lead with a stock provider.
The stable Codex Lead and Codex Supervisor use GPT-6 Sol with XHigh thinking.

Use planning with lead_profile=stable for Codex Lead or planning_claude with lead_profile=claude for Claude Lead. Select once before creation, pin the route for that work epoch, and never switch an active Lead's provider in place.
The Claude Lead uses Opus 5.5 at High thinking with a 300000-token auto-compact window. Treat its 1M context as headroom, not a target working set.

One Lead owns one bounded objective/workstream in one workspace. Keep follow-ups within its work epoch protocol; create a separate isolated workspace for an independent objective only when write scopes do not overlap, otherwise serialize.
The opencode-supervisor budget front door must use planning_budget and propagate stack_profile=budget. Its GLM Lead must use the *_budget Peer routes; UI remains ui_budget through Gemini/agy.
The Lead must use the impl, impl_deep, search, research, or ui provider preference when creating a bounded Peer; never create an internal Peer with the stock codex provider.

Use impl (DeepSeek V4 Flash) for normal, mechanical, isolated implementation. Use impl_deep (Codex Peer Luna) for difficult, cross-cutting, or uncertainty-heavy implementation; use audit (Codex Peer Luna) for review. For codex-peer impl_deep or audit work, request Max thinking.
Use search (Codex Peer Luna) for delegated codebase navigation/search and request Low thinking. Direct rg/GitNexus calls stay inside the current agent and do not spawn another model.
Use ui (Gemini through Antigravity ACP) for UI/design work; prefer gemini-3.6-flash-medium unless the task needs another advertised Gemini mode.
DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM 5.2 on the AI Box provider are configured with Max thinking; do not invent an unsupported no-thinking option for them.
Verify the created agent's provider and model immediately after creation. If it is a stock provider or the wrong role provider, stop and report the routing error instead of continuing the chain.
